Definition: from G5064 and G1137; four-cornered, i.e. square:--foursquare.
BiblicalUsage: tetrágōnos is the word for foursquare. In Revelation 21:16, the city lieth foursquare.
TheologicalSignificance: A city lying foursquare, equal on every side, gives me a picture of a home God built to last and to hold everyone He loves.
